subject: Kickoff: principal-subspace aux tasks for retrieval
body:
Hi all,

Kicking off the aux-tasks workstream. Basis: our open-source SGD algorithm for learning principal subspaces. The bet is that subspace features learned as auxiliary tasks give our retrieval models better representations than the PCA-style preprocessing we run today, and that the LISSA-based estimator makes it cheap enough to run at full corpus scale.

Plan: reproduce the synthetic-matrix and MNIST experiments in May (the 50x50 synthetic configs with d=10 are the sanity bar); scale the estimator to our retrieval embedding matrices in June; full-scale pretraining sweep plus eval readout in July; launch review before window close on 8/10.

Alina - staffing and the compute reservation are the long poles, can you kick those off this week?

Anders
